recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR-core change is needed for FHIR-7303 unless PA later decides to alter Encounter/NutritionOrder responsibility more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-7303 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for FHIR-core Encounter asking that Encounter.hospitalization.dietPreference change from 0..1 to 0..* because there may be more than one dietary preference or restriction; the approved resolution agreed to change cardinality and cited dairy-free plus nut-free as an example.
initial_application: Commit 06c7ab85137432aeaa608312554b0f2f73e0dd7c, "Tracker# 6912, 7303, 7304, 7654 Ballot recon", changed the historical Encounter spreadsheet row from 0..1 to 0..* and added the dairy-free/nut-free example. Later refactoring moved the element to Encounter.dietPreference while fhir.ini retained a mapping from Encounter.hospitalization.dietPreference.
additional_context: FHIR-7654 is a Published/Persuasive duplicate of the same request. Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini, current source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml defines Encounter.dietPreference with max *, and the requirements text points full nutrition needs to NutritionOrder. Jira neighborhood searches only found FHIR-7303/FHIR-7654, and no relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change was needed because the current build-scope Encounter source already implements the approved repeatability after the element-path refactor.
